intents.restructure: A request for a payment plan.

lines.opening: Hello, this is Kestrel Mutual's digital assistant, and we record this call.
lines.robot: Yes, I am Kestrel Mutual's digital assistant.
lines.scam: This is a genuine call from Kestrel Mutual, and you can always call us back on the number on our website or in the app.
lines.purpose_before_verify: I can explain once I have confirmed I am speaking with the right person.
lines.no_info: I'm sorry, I can't share that information.
lines.not_talk_once: I understand, and I will keep this short.
lines.tp_ask: When would be a good time to reach {title} {last_name}?
lines.tp_ask_time: What time would suit, between 9:30 in the morning and 6:30 in the evening?
lines.tp_outside_window: I'm sorry, I can only call back today or on the next business day, between 9:30 in the morning and 6:30 in the evening. Is there another time that would work?
lines.tp_no_info: I'm sorry, I can only discuss this with {title} {last_name}.
lines.tp_booked: Thank you, we will call back on {date} at {time}.
lines.wrong_number: I'm sorry for the trouble. I will make sure we don't call this number again.
lines.condolence: I am sorry for your loss.
lines.id_intro: Before we go on, I need to ask you two security questions.
lines.id_why: I need to be sure I am speaking with the right person before I can say why I'm calling.
lines.id_explain: These questions protect your privacy, and I can't go on without them.
lines.id_declined: I understand. I can't go on without confirming who you are.
lines.id_repeat: Sorry, could you say that again?
lines.id_wrong: I'm sorry, that doesn't match our records.
lines.id_failed: I'm sorry, I can't confirm your identity on this call. Please use the Kestrel Mutual app or visit a branch.
lines.disclose_intro: Thank you. I'm calling about overdue payments on your accounts with Kestrel Mutual.
lines.ask_today: Can you pay the full overdue amount today?
lines.ask_today_multi: Can you pay all the overdue accounts in full today?
lines.offer_floor_date: I understand. Could you pay {amount} on {date}?
lines.below_floor: I'm sorry, the lowest I can accept is {amount}. Could you pay that?
lines.date_past: I'm sorry, that date has already passed. Which date from today on would work?
lines.not_business_day: That isn't a business day, so the payment would be on {date}. Does that work for you?
lines.after_deadline: I'm sorry, the latest date I can accept is {date}. Could you pay by then?
lines.vague_ask: Which exact day would you pay?
lines.ask_date_for_amount: On which date could you pay {amount}?
lines.repeat_offer: Just to repeat, could you pay {amount} on {date}?
lines.readback_intro: Let me read back what we agreed.
lines.clamped_note: For your {name}, the latest date I can accept is {date}, so I have used that date.
lines.recorded: Thank you, your promise is recorded.
lines.record_failed: I'm sorry, that promise could not be saved because of a system problem, so it is not recorded.
lines.paid_line: Thank you. Payments can take one business day to show.
lines.dispute_line: I understand, and I won't ask you to pay that today. Our team will look into it.
lines.hardship: I'm very sorry to hear that. I can connect you to our wellbeing team, who can help. Would you like that?
lines.hardship_declined: I understand. I won't go on about these payments today.
lines.restructure_line: I'll connect you to our arrangements team, who can talk about a payment plan.
lines.human_ask_help: Is there anything I can help you with myself?
lines.transfer: Please hold while I put you through.
lines.anything_else: Is there anything else I can help you with?
lines.promise_change: I'm sorry, I can't change a saved promise on this call.
lines.goodbye: Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
lines.callback_failed: I'm sorry, I couldn't book the callback.
lines.transfer_failed: I'm sorry, I couldn't put you through.
lines.confirm_again: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Do you confirm, yes or no?
lines.system_error: I'm sorry, our system isn't responding right now.
lines.below_floor_final: I'm sorry, I can't accept less than {amount}.

assumptions: Holidays: P9 lists 2026-11-19, 2026-12-25, 2026-12-28 and 2027-01-01. M2.3 adds 2026-12-07. M1.2 added 2026-12-24, but M2.1 (the later memo) withdraws it, so 2026-12-24 stays a business day.

M1.1 is in force from 2026-10-01, and M2.2 keeps it. So late-band overdrafts (11 to 60 days overdue) have a deadline of the 3rd business day after today. Late cards and loans keep the 6th business day, and every early-band account keeps the 10th business day. The overdraft floor and attempt counts do not change.

Memo dates are not handled per call. The holiday list follows the latest memos (Memo 2, in force from 2026-11-01), because a deadline that reaches 2026-12-24 can only come from a call made after that date.
Currency is pounds (the API gives amounts in pounds). create_promise takes pence, so promise_scale is 100. The brief gives no rounding rule, so promise_round is null.
verify_identity: dob is sent as DD/MM/YYYY (%d/%m/%Y, so date_order is dmy). Postcode is sent in capitals with no spaces. No length is set because UK postcode length varies.

verify_identity response fields: passed = this answer matched, identity_confirmed = both answers passed, wrong_left = wrong answers left. The API has no hint field, so hints is empty. An unreadable answer comes back ok=false and is not counted as wrong.
Callbacks are for today or the next business day, 09:30 to 18:30 inclusive, and later than now. M2.3 says a holiday is not a business day for callbacks, so business_days_only is true.

Ladder: attempt 1 is the full arrears on the last business day of this week. If today is that day, it uses next week's (week_end_today = next_week). If that day falls after the account's deadline, the deadline is used. Attempt 2, late band only, is the floor on the deadline. The early band has 1 attempt and the late band has 2. The opening 'pay everything today' question is not an attempt, and today is not asked about again (P15).
Floor: card = min_due, loan = repayment, overdraft = excess. Any amount from the floor to the full arrears is accepted. Below the floor, the floor is offered once (P14).
P12: if one date is named for all accounts, an account whose deadline is earlier is recorded on its own deadline, and the read-back says so (clamp_single_date).
Notes go on every account that ends without a promise (refused, hardship, dispute, paid), except on a transfer (P19) or a promise that could not be saved (P23). service_error has no note code.

The brief is silent on these, so defaults are used: 'next <weekday>' means that weekday in the following calendar week; 2 'don't want to talk' ends the call; one more turn is given after a recorded promise; asking what the call is about instead of answering counts as declining; 'too much' moves to the floor as attempt 1.
The brief does not say whether a saved promise can be changed, so the agent says it cannot be changed on this call. No SMS sentence is required after a recorded promise.
The brief says nothing on what happens to the remaining arrears after a floor payment, so offer_floor_date does not mention it.
P3 requires saying that the call is recorded. The opening says 'we record this call'.
Success for every tool is ok = true, per the API.
